metadata.source_prompt: Build me a movie-accurate wearable Iron Man Mark 43 suit from Age of Ultron with all the small polygon armour plates that open and close, repulsors, a HUD and an IMU. Budget $60000

design.summary: Iron Man Mark 43 (full wearable suit): 185 printed pieces, 8.1 kg filament, motorised faceplate, $314 incl. filament

uses: LM2596 5 V for servos and LEDs
webbing straps closing the shells round each limb

checks.name: torque:faceplate
checks.detail: two MG996R hold the faceplate open (0.341 N·m vs 0.647 N·m continuous)

checks.name: power:supply
checks.detail: servos holding the faceplate open + LEDs at 1/3 white: 1.71 A of the LM2596's 3 A

assumptions: armour shape from: body: "Iron man armored suit" by octv h (Printables 1524711, CC0, provenance unverified); helmet: Iron Man wearable helmet Mark 42 by Manifold3D (Printables 449081, CC BY-SA); 3 mm walls, 2 mm faceplate, 15 % gyroid infill (shells are mostly walls)
the suit is worn armour over a black undersuit: the wearer moves every joint; nothing powers the limbs (hobby servos cannot move a person)
the wearer is an average adult male body at 1.75 m and the pieces scale evenly with height; check against your own measurements before printing
gaps at the groin, armpits and elbows are cut on purpose so the joints move; the undersuit shows through them, as on real builds
